reviews.title: Recalibrate JPEG-XR BitmapData.encode and raw SWF Loader status after audit
reviews.summary: Updates Function note for Adobe AS3 EvalError #1066 on new Function(body), demotes BitmapData.encode, JPEGXREncoderOptions, and BitmapEncodingColorSpace to partial after replacing non-standard zlib .jxr containers with an explicit profile error, and demotes Loader.load/loadBytes to partial for bounded SWF bytecode.

entries.note: Encodes bounded sub-rectangles into RFC-2083 PNG and JFIF JPEG ByteArrays via PNGEncoderOptions and JPEGEncoderOptions; JPEGXREncoderOptions validates options and throws an explicit HTML5/WASM profile error because ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding is not implemented.
Options descriptor class holding quantization, colorSpace, and trimFlexBits properties; ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented in the HTML5/WASM profile.

Constructs JPEGXREncoderOptions with defaults quantization = 20, colorSpace = BitmapEncodingColorSpace.COLORSPACE_AUTO, and trimFlexBits = 0; ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.
Stores and validates BitmapEncodingColorSpace ('auto', '4:4:4', '4:2:2', '4:2:0'); ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.
Stores and validates JPEG-XR quantization parameter (0..100); ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.
Stores and validates JPEG-XR trimFlexBits parameter (0..15); ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.
Enumeration class defining chroma subsampling constants for JPEGXREncoderOptions; ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.
Constant '4:2:0' consumed by JPEGXREncoderOptions validation; ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.
Constant '4:2:2' consumed by JPEGXREncoderOptions validation; ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.
Constant '4:4:4' consumed by JPEGXREncoderOptions validation; ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.
Constant 'auto' consumed by JPEGXREncoderOptions validation; ITU-T T.832 .jxr bitstream encoding in BitmapData.encode is not implemented.

Loads PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP images, NeoFlash HTML5 child bundles, and bounded FWS/CWS/ZWS SWF movies (shapes, sprites, bitmaps, text, timelines, and sandboxed subset AVM1/AVM2 frame/document-class bytecode with unload/reparenting cleanup); unsupported SWF opcodes, closures, non-root SymbolClass bindings, and PlaceObject3 filters emit explicit warnings.

Decodes in-memory PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP ByteArrays and bounded FWS/CWS/ZWS SWF ByteArrays into live Bitmap or MovieClip content with sandboxed subset AVM1/AVM2 bytecode and unload/reparenting cleanup; unsupported SWF opcodes, closures, non-root SymbolClass bindings, and PlaceObject3 filters emit explicit warnings.
